description: This Flex lexer stores number values in the declared union member and returns grammar tokens.

steps.description: The lexer includes calculator and generated parser headers, disables yywrap, and begins its rules.
The number rule stores into yylval.number. Operator, parenthesis, and newline rules return their named tokens.
Whitespace is skipped. The catch-all rule reports an unexpected character and exits.

title: Return typed lexer tokens
